384b3(rgyud): ni kun du 'byung ba thogs pa med pa'i dus dang rnam pa thams cad du 'gag pa med pa'o//yongs su dag pa chos kyi dbyings mngon par byang chub pa'i/tha dad par dmigs pa med pa'i ye shes kyi sku sangs rgyas 
384b4(rgyud): thams cad kyi byang chub kyi sems dus gsum thog mtha' kun tu dkyil 'khor chen po gsang ba'i bde ba chen po sku gsung thugs rdo rje dam tshig gi 'khor los zhi ba dang khro bo'i sku sna tshogs su snang ba'o//longs 
384b5(rgyud): spyod rdzogs pa mtshan dpe ldan//yab yum bde chen ngo bo nyid//snying rje chen po tshad med pas//rgyun mi 'chad par bsam pa dang //mthun par 'jug pas zhi mi 'gyur//rang bzhin med pas mi 'gyur ba'o//
384b6(rgyud): dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa bzhi bcu pa'o////de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs//dpag med 'dus pa thams cad kyi//rtag tu dga' ba'i gzugs can mchog/bcom 
384b7(rgyud): ldan rdo rje 'chang chen gyi//gsung dbyangs rdo rje sgra sgrogs pa//nye ba nyid du thos pa yis//bde ba dang ni yid bde thob//de nyid du ni skad cig la//yang dag ting 'dzin sgo thob cing //rmad byung ye shes dbyangs kyis bstod//
384b8(rgyud): chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang //thugs rje tshad med 'gro skyob mdzad//byang chub ye shes gtso chen po//bde chen dpe bral phyag 'tshal lo//rdo rje gsang ba mi 'gyur ba//mchog tu gyur pa bde chen po//
385a1(rgyud): @#//thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i//gar gyi bdag po phyag 'tshal lo//drag po ma rungs thams cad kun//gsung gi dngos zil gnon cing //'jigs byed bdud 'dul chen po nyid//
385a2(rgyud): rgyal ba rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal//chos rnams mi zad mdzod thob pas//'gro ba kun la gter sbyin mdzad//dbang phyug bla med phyag rgya che//cod pan gtsug tor phyag 'tshal lo//'jig rten dbang bsgyur sa gsum 
385a3(rgyud): pa||dri med nor bu chen po ste//mtshungs med sgyu 'phrul rgyal po che//byang chub snying po phyag 'tshal lo//zhes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/dpal rdo rje 'chang chen po la yang dag par bstod pa'o//
385a4(rgyud): de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa la sogs pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po la sogs pa dpag tu med pa/dga' mgu yid rangs te/chos thams cad mnyam 
385a5(rgyud): pa nyid du rtogs pas/ci yang mi smra bar gyur to//dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa bzhi bcu rtsa gcig pa'o////slob dpon chen po zla ba grags pa las rim par brgyud pa/dpal
